snippet.title: غسان بن جدو | Ghassan Ben Jeddo
snippet.description:
Ghassan Ben Jeddo (غسان بن جدو) is a veteran Tunisian / Lebanese journalist and activist. He is currently the director of the Beirut-based pan-Arab satellite TV channel, AlMayadeen. In addition to interviewing the most powerful Arab leaders and politicians, Ghassan Bin Jeddo has his own show where he analyzes and comments on the latest political happenings in the world with a focus on the Middle East region.

غسان بن جدو هو صحفي تونسي - لبناني. هو حاليا مدير قناة الميادين الفضائية ومقرها بيروت. بالإضافة إلى إجراء المقابلات الحصرية مع القادة والسياسيين العرب الأكثر نفوذا،  لدى غسان بن جدو برنامجه الخاص حيث يحلل ويعلق على آخر الأحداث السياسية في العالم مع التركيز على منطقة الشرق الأوسط

• Fi Al Mayadeen (في الميادين)
• Hiwar Khass (حوار خاص)
•Tammouz Al Hikaya (تموز الحكاية)

snippet.title: Karen Davila
snippet.description:
OFFICIAL LAUNCH: May 1, 2021

I am Karen, a broadcast journalist, an empowered woman, a working mother, a lover of Jesus, your friend. Love you all!

WHO IS KAREN DAVILA?

Karen Davila is a multi awarded broadcast journalist and news anchor of ABSCBN. She has been awarded the much coveted TOYM (Ten Outstanding Young Men), TOWNS (The Outstanding Women In The Nation’s Service) for MEDIA and is in the Hall of Fame of the ANAK TV Awards. Several of her documentaries for The Correspondents have received international recogniton. Today, Karen is best known for her provocative interviews on HEADSTART, her daily morning show on ANC.

Get to know Karen personally in her YouTube channel as a working woman and mother. Here, she not only reveals more of herself, she shares stories of people in a different light, hoping to leave you inspired and happy.

Thank you for visiting our home page. Please don’t forget to subscribe!

snippet.title: Sergio Novelli
snippet.description:
¡Bienvenidos a mi canal de YouTube! Soy Sergio Novelli, periodista venezolano radicado en Miami, y te invito a que me acompañes de lunes a viernes a las 8:00 am (hora Miami) en mi programa en vivo "Al Día con Sergio."

Con más de 30 años de experiencia en medios de comunicación, desde mis inicios en RCTV hasta mi trabajo actual en Estados Unidos, he dedicado mi carrera a informar con profesionalismo y compromiso.

Aquí, encontrarás entrevistas exclusivas, análisis profundo como “A Fondo” y el contexto necesario para entender mejor el mundo y las historias que impactan a la comunidad hispana.

Y además, otras secciones de interés general como “Letras Eternas”, “Top 5 del Tiempo”, “Curiosidades que conectan” y más. 

Únete a esta comunidad informada y participa en cada transmisión.
¡Suscríbete y mantente al día con las noticias que realmente importan!

snippet.title: daroha
snippet.description:
усім салют! я - блогер daroha. ну і так, "daroha" вымаўляецца як "дарога": гэта ж беларуская лацінка, сябры!

гэта мой канал, які я быў стварыў яшчэ тады, калі youtube толькі толькі пачынаўся (можаце называць мяне старажылам youtube, не памылецеся!). найперш спрабую тут фармуляваць свае ўласныя разважаньні пра Беларусь і дзяліцца імі з вамі. але таксама можна знайсьці тут і мае песьні, і нават мульты, да якіх яшчэ можа калісьці зноўку вярнуся.

ну і, канешне ж, найбольш важнае для мяне тут - вашая зваротная сувязь! думаць Беларусь разам - гэта куды цікавей і прадуктыўней, чым у самоце! дык падпісвайцеся, камэнтуйце, дзяліцеся відэа зь сябрамі й ворагамі!

будзе цікава!

____________
via est vita

snippet.title: The Ultimate Classical Music Guide by Dave Hurwitz
snippet.description:
Enjoy more than 6,000 videos featuring critic David Hurwitz, founder and Executive Editor of ClassicsToday.com, covering the best and worst classical music recordings, as well as  commentary and discussion of all things classical. This is classical music for pleasure, without the usual snobbery and "high culture" BS. Check out conveniently organized playlists for beginners and aficionados alike, grouping videos by composer, work type, ideal recording lists, historical period--everything you need to enrich your knowledge, satisfy your curiosity and have a great time listening. 

A music critic for more than three decades, David Hurwitz holds MA degrees from Johns Hopkins and Stanford Universities. Hurwitz is the author of more than a dozen books on composers such as Mozart, Mahler, Sibelius, Haydn, Dvorák, Brahms, Beethoven, Shostakovich, R. Strauss Bernstein, Handel, C.P.E. Bach, and Mendelssohn. His musicological articles have been published in noted scholarly journals as well.

snippet.title: Портников. Аргументы
snippet.description: Канал Виталия Портникова о происходящем на постсоветском пространстве и в мире. Здесь я хочу продолжить работу, начатую еще в конце 80-х-начале 90-х годов прошлого века, с появлением первых независимых медиа в Советском Союзе и на постсоветском пространстве. В условиях, когда территория честного слова с каждым днем сжимается, как шагреневая кожа, наше общение приобретает особое значение, становится поддержкой тем, кто не сдается даже сейчас и стремится говорить правду.
